articles.title: Building the future of finance in the age of AI
articles.summary: Jessica Rusu, FCA chief data, information and intelligence officerat Bloomberg's UK Policy Series. The Mills ReviewThat is why we commissioned the Mills Review, published in July, focused on how AI could reshape retail financial services by 2030.Some developments we anticipated are already emerging, including the transition towards agentic finance, such as the launch of Meta’s Muse.Our response to the review is not to consult, study and report progress.Our focus is testing, assurance, monitoring and surveillance: directly with industry to understand how AI systems are being deployed.Whilst the Review focused on retail, the AI shift does not stop at the retail boundary.Across wholesale markets too, AI is accelerating how firms analyse, trade, monitor and make decisions.We are embedding 6 of the 7 recommendations into live work immediately. Our innovation services such as the AI Lab give us direct insight into what firms are building from agent-led payments and fraud detection to consume
